articles.title: Exploring Our Changing Planet
articles.description: 地球環境をテーマにした英文読解
articles.content: Our planet is constantly changing. Scientists use satellites to observe the oceans, forests, and atmosphere. These observations help researchers understand how the environment changes over time.\n\nBy comparing new information with older records, scientists can identify patterns and ask better questions about the future.

articles.title: A Change to the Meeting Schedule
articles.description: ビジネスメールを読む練習
articles.content:
Dear Team,

Please note that Thursday's project meeting has been moved from 10:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. The location remains the same.

If you cannot attend at the new time, please contact me by Wednesday afternoon. Thank you for your flexibility.

Best regards,
Alex

articles.title: The Secret of the Old Library
articles.description: 短い物語で英文を読む
articles.content: Mia found a small key inside an old book. A note beside it said, 'Look behind the blue door.'\n\nThe next morning, she returned to the library and began searching for the door. She did not know what she would find, but she was excited to discover the answer.
